title: 第968章 鬼神云爆提前爆发第967章 半步天纹的尸体用来打窝
slug: 刻刀一把雕出天上白玉京
content_zh:
“咔擦。”
清脆的破碎声音响彻。
一道身影徐徐睁开眼眸，俊美无比的面庞之上，浮现出了凝重之色，他那血红色的发丝，宛如火焰羽毛般，飘扬不休。
“孔磊……死了。”
人影眉头皱起，眼眸之中闪烁过一抹不可思议。
孔磊什么修为？
在进入黑魔原之前，就已经是地源境圆满，按照计划，孔磊进入黑魔原后，就会寻地方突破到半步天纹。
只要突破到了半步天纹，以孔磊的实力，绝对很难死去。
因为，在鬼神云爆爆发之前，黑魔原中真正能威胁到他生命的，只有人族修士。
而青云城的人族，这一次被打了个信息差，根本不知晓这一次进入黑魔原的鬼兽族和神灵族修士，来的都是地纹境的顶级妖孽！
青云城中，自然也有地纹境的顶级妖孽，像是青云门，像是青云军部等等，都培养着顶级的地纹境修士。
但是，这一次进入黑魔原的，不过是参加百府天工的修士而已。
哪怕有天骄妖孽，修为上也绝不可能达到地源境圆满，就更莫要说半步天纹了。
“可是……孔磊真的死了，他的生命气息彻底消失，我已经无法感应到他的血脉联系。”
孔笙扬起他那张极其俊美的面容。
黑魔原中，有这样的危险吗？能杀死半步天纹层次修士的危险？
是谁？
神灵族的那些绝代妖孽出手了？
共衍、共离，还是谁？
他轻轻摇了摇头：“不对劲啊……”

“罢了，在鬼神云爆未曾爆发之前，我哪里都不去了。”
“也不宜去，这黑魔原，如今已经有些诡异的超出预料了，太危险了。”
“我血孔雀一族修士入黑魔原，就是为了那神灵洞府的传承……一切都不能出问题。”
孔笙轻轻开口，随后他盘膝而坐，继续修炼。
此刻的他，修为已经突破到了半步天纹，但是也就仅此而已了，他虽然天赋妖孽超绝。
可是想要突破到天纹境，太难了，没有足够的沉淀与积累，难如登天！
也许这一次的神灵洞府有这份机缘。
他必须要把握住这份机缘，冲击天纹！
对于他们这些鬼兽族地纹境中的绝代妖孽而言，天纹境不是问题，但是突破的快或者慢就是问题了。
拖的越久，他们打破天源境的可能性就越低，可能这辈子的造化，也就只能卡在教主级了。
孔笙仰起头，血发飞扬，眸中野心之火，燎原焚烧！
“教主级？”
“我可不愿止步于此！”
……
……
轰隆隆——
可怕的能量涟漪在密林中炸开，强大的鬼神之力爆发，彼此碰撞。
content_en:
"Kacha."
The crisp breaking sound resounded.
A figure slowly opened his eyes, a solemn look appeared on his extremely handsome face, and his blood-red hair was flying like flaming feathers.
"Kong Lei...is dead."
The figure's brows furrowed, and a hint of disbelief flashed in his eyes.
What kind of cultivation level is Kong Lei?
Before entering the Black Demon Plain, he had already reached the perfection of the Earth Source Realm. According to the plan, after Kong Lei entered the Black Demon Plain, he would find a place to break through to the half-step sky pattern.
As long as he breaks through to the half-step sky pattern, it will definitely be difficult to die with Kong Lei's strength.
Because, before the explosion of ghosts and gods, the only people in the Black Demonic Plain who could truly threaten his life were the human monks.
The human race in Qingyun City was hit with an information gap this time. They had no idea that the monks from the ghost beast race and the spiritual race who entered the Black Demon Plain this time were all top level monsters from the earth pattern realm!
In Qingyun City, there are naturally top level monsters in the Earth Pattern Realm, such as Qingyun Sect, Qingyun Military Headquarters, etc., all of which cultivate top Earth Pattern Realm monks.
However, the people who entered the Black Demon Plain this time were only the monks who participated in the Baifu Tiangong.
Even if there are geniuses and monsters, it is impossible to reach the perfection of the Earth Origin Realm in terms of cultivation, let alone the half-step heaven mark.
"But...Kong Lei is really dead. His life breath has completely disappeared, and I can no longer sense his blood connection."
Kong Sheng raised his extremely handsome face.
Is there such a danger in the Black Demon Plain? A danger that can kill a half-step Heavenly Pattern level monk?
Who is it?
Have those peerless monsters from the Spirit Clan taken action?
Co-evolution, co-separation, or who?
He shook his head slightly: "Something's wrong..."
"That's all, I won't go anywhere before the Ghost Cloud Explosion breaks out."
"It's not advisable to go. This Black Demonic Plain is now a little weirder than expected. It's too dangerous."
"I, a monk from the Blood Peacock clan, entered the Black Demon Plains just for the inheritance of the Divine Spirit Cave... Nothing can go wrong."
Kong Sheng spoke softly, then sat cross-legged and continued practicing.
At this moment, his cultivation has reached the half-step level of Heavenly Mark, but that's all. Although he is extremely talented, he is a monster.
But it is too difficult to break through to the sky pattern realm. Without enough precipitation and accumulation, it is as difficult as climbing to the sky!
Maybe this time the Divine Cave has such an opportunity.
He must seize this opportunity and attack the sky pattern!
For these peerless monsters in the Earth Pattern Realm of the Ghost Beast Clan, the Sky Pattern Realm is not a problem, but the speed or slowness of the breakthrough is a problem.
The longer they delay, the less likely they are to break through the Tianyuan realm, and they may only be stuck at the leader level in this lifetime.
Kong Sheng raised his head, his blood flying, and the fire of ambition in his eyes was like a prairie fire!
"Teacher level?"
"I don't want to stop here!"
…
…
Rumble——
Terrible energy ripples exploded in the dense forest, and powerful ghosts and gods exploded and collided with each other.
